caption: The video captures a close-up, wide-angle view of a horizontal wooden beam coated with frozen, vertically streaked drips of water. A row of slender icicles hangs from the bottom edge of the beam, their clear forms catching the bright sunlight that illuminates the left and center portions of the wood. A sharp diagonal shadow falls across the right side of the beam, contrasting with the sunlit areas. Beneath the beam on the left, a small green paper tag dangles, while the pale paved surface below is crossed by the shadow of a railing and a thin orange line. Blurred background objects, including a red sign and metallic cans, sit at the top edge of the frame. Across the sequence, the frozen formations and surface droplets show no visible change, with no dripping appearing and the lighting pattern holding steady.
